A researcher took a standard electronic voting machine, opened a specialized backend software editor—which had no business being on that machine—and manually swapped the vote totals between Candidate 1 and Candidate 2. It took him under 60 seconds. ⏱️

Fast forward to 2026: Trump, high-level military intelligence, and the Q-team have spent six years laying the trap. They now possess ironclad, irrefutable digital telemetry and physical evidence of machine manipulation. Whether we go through Scenario 1 or Scenario 2, the fraud is now 100% provable in court.

Taking her place as the new White House Chief of Staff is Stephen Miller—a stone-cold Trump loyalist who will execute the President's vision without compromise or hesitation. 🛡️

text:
One of the architects of Texas electricity deregulation argues the success of his program. But there's a fundamental error in his argument: he's comparing the retail price at the start (which was an outlier year due to high gas prices) to *offer prices* today. That's not an accurate reflection of what Texan households actually pay since, unlike businesses, they are not constantly switching electricity providers to the cheapest offer.

The first chart here shows a distribution of the number of residential customers by actual price paid in 2025. Virtually none of them paid the ~10c/kWh price that Wood is showing as being offered today. They paid closer to 18c/kWh on average, in contrast to 13c/kWh for public power customers. Maybe retailers charged way more in 2025 than they are today, or maybe the argument is totally bogus to begin with.

The second shows the past 35 years of average retail power prices for the competitive territories in ERCOT, before and after deregulation, in real 2025 dollars. The blue line shows the average price for the public power territories within ERCOT.

From divisions inside PHTK to the collapse of presidential security, a former Colombian commander’s testimony and a journalist’s account of mysterious overnight telephone calls raise questions about the political and security networks surrounding Haiti’s murdered president.

An examination of political relationships, media connections, courtroom testimony, and unresolved questions surrounding the assassination of President Jovenel Moïse.

THE NIGHT HAITI’S PRESIDENT WAS LEFT WITHOUT PROTECTION

In the early morning hours of July 7, 2021, armed men entered the private residence of Haitian President Jovenel Moïse in Pèlerin, above Port-au-Prince.

The president was shot and killed. His wife, Martine Moïse, was seriously wounded.

But one of the most consequential questions surrounding the assassination remains unresolved:

How could an armed operation reach the president’s bedroom without his security detail stopping the attackers?

Nearly five years later, testimony in Miami federal court has brought that question back into focus.

Former Colombian military personnel have described an operation involving intelligence about the presidential residence, logistical coordination, and alleged arrangements with Haitian security officers.

Former Haitian government official Joseph Félix Badio has emerged as a central figure in the prosecution’s account of the conspiracy.

Meanwhile, the political history surrounding Moïse’s presidency raises a separate question: How much control did the president exercise over a security establishment that included personnel whose careers began under his predecessor, Michel Martelly?

And there is another, less-examined story.

Haitian historian and political commentator Michel Soukar says that during the night of the assassination, someone he described as a director at Radio Signal FM repeatedly attempted to telephone him.

When Soukar finally returned the call around 5 a.m., the individual informed him that Jovenel Moïse had been killed and offered to send photographs.

The account opens a new investigative avenue into the early circulation of information about the assassination.

To understand why these questions matter, it is necessary to examine the political relationships that developed long before July 7, 2021.

INSIDE THE ASSASSINATION OF JOVENEL MOÏSE: THE MARTELLY NETWORK, PRESIDENTIAL SECURITY, SIGNAL FM, MICHEL SOUKAR AND THE BADIO CONNECTION

text:
In July 1943, American and British forces invaded Sicily as part of Operation Husky, opening a new front against Axis forces in Europe.

Palermo was captured by General George S. Patton's Seventh Army on July 22, and the entire island was secured by August 17. The campaign helped bring about the fall of Benito Mussolini's government.

For Italian-American soldiers, the invasion also offered an unusual opportunity to reconnect with relatives in their ancestral homeland. One of them was Vincent J.
Crivello of Milwaukee, Wisconsin, who found three of his cousins in Palermo. Photographer Nick Parrino captured their reunion over ice cream in September 1943.

At the time of this photo, Italy had just surrendered to the Allies on September 8, although fighting against German forces continued. In the middle of a world war, four cousins were simply enjoying ice cream together.

米勒这口才了得……

I’m reminded of a famous expression, the storm whispers to the warrior that you cannot withstand my strength, and the warrior whispers back, I am the storm.
我想到一句著名的话：风暴对战士低语说“你无法抵挡我的力量”，而战士回低语道：“我就是风暴。”
We are the storm, and our enemies cannot comprehend our strength, our determination, our resolve, our passion.
我们就是风暴，我们的敌人无法理解我们的力量、我们的决心、我们的毅力和我们的热情。
Our lineage and our legacy hails back to Athens, to Rome, to Philadelphia, to Monticello.
我们的血脉与遗产可以追溯到雅典、罗马、费城，再到蒙蒂塞洛。
Our ancestors built the cities, they produced the art and architecture, they built the industry.
我们的祖先建造了城市，创造了艺术与建筑，建立了工业。
Thousands of years of warriors who raised up families, raised up cities, raised up industry, raised up civilization, who pulled us out of the caves and the darkness into the light.
数千年来，一代代战士养育了家庭、建立了城市、发展了工业、创造了文明，把我们从洞穴和黑暗中拉进了光明。
The light will defeat the dark.
光明终将战胜黑暗。
We will prevail over the forces of wickedness and evil.
我们必将战胜邪恶与罪恶的势力。
They cannot imagine what they have awakened.
他们无法想象自己唤醒了什么。
They cannot conceive of the army that they have arisen in all of us.
他们无法理解自己在我们所有人心中唤醒了一支怎样的军队。
Because we stand for what is good, what is virtuous, what is noble.
因为我们站在善良、美德与高尚的一边。
And to those trying to incite violence against us, those trying to foment hatred against us, what do you have?
而对那些试图煽动暴力、挑起仇恨针对我们的人，你们又有什么？
You have nothing. You are nothing.
你们一无所有。你们什么都不是。
You are wickedness, you are jealousy, you are envy, you are hatred. You are nothing.
你们是邪恶，是嫉妒，是羡慕，是仇恨。你们什么都不是。
You can build nothing. You can produce nothing. You can create nothing.
你们建不成任何东西。你们生产不出任何东西。你们创造不了任何东西。
We are the ones who build. We are the ones who create. We are the ones who lift up humanity.
我们才是建设者。我们才是创造者。我们才是提升人类的人。
You cannot defeat us. You cannot slow us. You cannot stop us. You cannot deter us.
你们打不败我们。你们挡不住我们。你们阻止不了我们。你们吓不倒我们。
You have no idea the dragon you have awakened.
你们根本不知道自己唤醒了一条怎样的龙。
You have no idea how determined we will be to save this civilization, to save the West, to save this republic.
你们根本不知道我们拯救这个文明、拯救西方、拯救这个共和国的决心有多么坚定。
Because our children are strong, and our grandchildren will be strong, and our children’s children’s children will be strong.
因为我们的孩子是坚强的，我们的孙子会是坚强的，我们孩子的孩子的孩子也会是坚强的。
And what will you leave behind? Nothing. Nothing.
而你们会留下什么？什么都没有。什么都没有。
To our enemies, you have nothing to give, you have nothing to offer, you have nothing to share, but bitterness.
对我们的敌人来说，你们给不出任何东西，提不出任何东西，分享不出任何东西，只有苦涩。
We have beauty, we have light, we have goodness, we have determination, we have vision, we have strength.
我们拥有美，拥有光明，拥有善良，拥有决心，拥有愿景，拥有力量。
We built the world that we inhabit now. Generation by generation, and we will defend this world.
我们一代又一代地建造了我们现在居住的世界，我们也将保卫这个世界。
We will defend goodness. We will defend light. We will defend virtue.
我们会保卫善良。我们会保卫光明。我们会保卫美德。
You cannot terrify us. You cannot frighten us. You cannot threaten us.
你们吓不倒我们。你们震慑不了我们。你们威胁不了我们。
Because we are on the side of goodness. We are on the side of God.
因为我们站在善良的一边。我们站在上帝的一边。

text:
An Iranian-born British Army corporal was arrested for espionage in Afghanistan in 2006.

Daniel James was serving in the Territorial Army in 2006 when he was called up for duty in Afghanistan. While there he began working as an interpreter for General Sir David Richards, commander of NATO forces in country. James was born as Esmail Mohammed Beigi Gamasai in Tehran before moving to the United Kingdom at age 15, where he legally changed his name in 1997.

James had a colorful background, having worked as a salsa-dancing instructor at the Falmer School in Brighton, and participating in the Mr. Universe competition in the late 1990s. He also boasted of having been trained as a voodoo priest in Cuba and later claimed during his trial to have performed black magic rituals in Afghanistan using tarot cards and seashells to protect General Richards.

His fellow servicemembers considered him eccentric at best, but his Farsi language skills were in high demand. While working as General Richards’ interpreter, he was often privy to high-level strategic discussions with senior members of the Afghan government. He also went on at least one official visit to the Iranian embassy in Kabul, where he left a card with his personal contact information, rather than that of the General’s staff office.

Between September and December 2006, James communicated several times via phone and email with an Iranian military attaché named Colonel Mohammad Hossein Heydari. He offered information on Predator drones and the location of a planned military facility. In one email he wrote, “Any other work that you may have, I am at your service” and even signed at least one email to Colonel Heydari as “Esmail the interpreter”.

James was arrested before divulging any seriously damaging information, although a search of his possessions turned up a USB drive holding two sensitive documents. Prosecutors stated during his trial that he was still in the early stages of recruitment.

In November 2008, James was sentenced to ten years in prison but served only three. Afterwards he returned to work as a dance instructor and DJ using the name Dani Jay.

🇺🇦🇷🇺 BUDANOV: PUTIN’S RUSSIA IS FIGHTING TO KEEP AN EMPIRE ALIVE, NOT JUST TO CONQUER LAND.

Ukraine’s Kyrylo Budanov has offered a stark assessment of what he believes is driving Moscow’s war.

In his view, Vladimir Putin’s policies are not fundamentally different from those pursued under the Russian tsars or the Soviet Union.

The political systems have changed. The flags, leaders and official ideologies have changed. But Budanov argues that the underlying imperial ambitions have survived.

And that distinction matters when trying to understand Russia’s invasion of Ukraine.

According to Budanov, Moscow’s objective goes beyond occupying Ukrainian territory. He believes the Kremlin is fighting to preserve an imperial narrative in which Russia’s greatness depends on its ability to dominate neighboring nations.

From that perspective, Ukraine’s independence represents something more threatening to Moscow than the loss of territory: a direct challenge to the idea that Russia is entitled to control the political future of countries once ruled from Moscow.

Budanov also draws a historical conclusion.

Empires that once appeared permanent eventually disappeared, and he believes Russia will be no exception.

His argument is that military conquest cannot indefinitely sustain an imperial system whose neighbors increasingly reject its authority.

Russia may still possess enormous military resources, but Budanov’s warning concerns something deeper than battlefield strength.

A country can retain its borders, its army and its institutions while losing the imperial identity around which its leadership has built its ambitions.

And for Budanov, that is the fundamental struggle behind Putin’s war against Ukraine.

I’ve paid my mortgage through a side gig for the past 10 years.

That’s why I’m showing you what’s possible.

One side gig idea every day.

Side Gig 👉 Leave your W2 idea of the day:

START A HEADSTONE CLEANING BUSINESS! 🪦💰

Here's a side gig I bet most people have never considered.

And it's something you could potentially start while keeping your W2.

Think about how many people have parents, grandparents, and other loved ones buried in cemeteries hundreds or even thousands of miles away.

They want to keep their loved ones' graves looking nice.

But they can't always visit.

Over time, headstones can accumulate dirt, algae, and biological growth.

WHAT IF YOU STARTED A BUSINESS THAT HELPED FAMILIES MAINTAIN THEIR LOVED ONES' GRAVES?

Here's how I'd approach it.

1. LEARN THE SKILL

This isn't something where you grab a pressure washer and start cleaning.

In fact, that could permanently damage a headstone.

You need to learn proper preservation techniques for granite, marble, and other materials.

Some older or deteriorating stones shouldn't be cleaned at all without professional conservation guidance.

Research approved cleaning methods and obtain permission from the cemetery and the person authorized to care for the marker.

Start with newer, stable markers and appropriate training.

2. FIND YOUR FIRST CUSTOMERS

I'd start by contacting local cemeteries to understand their rules.

Then I'd advertise in community Facebook groups.

I'd also consider reaching out to:

• Funeral homes
• Cemetery associations
• Genealogy groups
• Local historical organizations
• Families who live outside the area

I'd be particularly interested in customers who live out of state.

Imagine someone living in Florida whose parents are buried in South Carolina.

They might appreciate having someone local who can maintain the grave and send them pictures.

3. HOW DO YOU MAKE MONEY?

Charge per cleaning appointment.

Your price would depend on the marker's size, condition, material, and the time required.

You could also offer:

• Seasonal grave visits
• Before-and-after photographs
• Flower placement, where permitted
• Light debris removal
• Scheduled memorial visits

RECURRING CUSTOMERS!

Families could schedule approved maintenance visits once or twice a year.

You could offer annual service packages.

Not every headstone needs frequent cleaning, so the service should be based on actual condition rather than unnecessary treatments.

4. HOW DO YOU SCALE IT?

Start by servicing a few cemeteries on weekends.

Develop relationships with families.

Build a reputation for respectful, careful work.

Once you have consistent demand, hire and properly train someone to perform the services.

Eventually, you could have multiple technicians covering different cemeteries and communities.

You handle the marketing, scheduling, and customer relationships.

Your employees handle the visits.

I'd start small.

Learn the business.

Find ONE customer.

Do an excellent job.

Ask for referrals.

Build from there.

THE GOAL ISN'T TO SPEND THE REST OF YOUR LIFE CLEANING HEADSTONES.

The goal is to eventually build a business where other people perform the work.

Could a headstone cleaning and gravesite care business eventually replace someone's W2 income?

We're Gonna Find Out!

QUESTION: If you lived several states away from where your parents or grandparents were buried, would you pay someone to maintain their gravesite and send you pictures?
